_comment: Effect manifest for scripts/post_generate_fixes.py. ``true`` records a fix that changes the generated tree; a string records a fix that changes nothing on the pinned schema set, and states why. Regenerate with `python scripts/post_generate_fixes.py --update-manifest`.

fixes.add_model_validator_to_product: No-op since #213 added an explicit discriminator to publisher_properties: Pydantic validates the union, and the body only prints.
fixes.fix_preview_render_self_reference: datamodel-code-generator 0.64.0 emits PreviewRender1..3 unqualified in creative/preview_render.py; the module-qualified form this fix rewrites appears nowhere.
fixes.fix_brand_manifest_references: Its target core/promoted_offerings.py is not generated — brand.json is in GENERATED_SCHEMA_EXCLUDE_FILES — and the unaliased brand_manifest.BrandManifest reference appears nowhere in the tree.
fixes.fix_enum_defaults: Its target core/brand_manifest.py is not generated, and bundled/media_buy/get_media_buys_response.py carries no matching health default and is removed by prune_unused_bundled_modules immediately after.
fixes.fix_preview_creative_request_discriminat: The literal it searches for (description='Request to generate previews) appears in no generated module, and PreviewCreativeRequest is one class rather than a union. The fix prints its success message without editing anything.
fixes.add_deprecated_field_metadata: The generator emits Field(deprecated=True) itself. Of the 363 top-level deprecated schema properties, 81 already carry it; the other 282 live under hyphenated schema directories that the schema-to-module mapping snake-cases in the basename only, so no candidate reaches the rewrite.
fixes.apply_open_payload_config: The 3.2 bundle declares x-adcp-open-payload on no named schema object; its 266 annotations are anonymous object fields the generator already emits as dict[str, Any].
fixes.fix_reuse_model_discriminator_bug: --reuse-model emits no Literal['reuse'] subclass on this bundle.
fixes.fix_publisher_tmpx_mapping_key_constrain: The generator emits the outer map key as Annotated[str, StringConstraints(...)]; the StringConstraints-only shape this fix repairs no longer appears.
